title: Unvalidated throughput_units feeds wrap-prone u32 credit math at the catalog trust boundary
evidence:
core/catalog.odin:361 (node_types loader — demand_weight/port_capacity are validated, throughput_units is not; no other validation site exists):
			nt.throughput_units = jint(eo, "throughput_units", 0)
core/flow.odin:609-613:
spawn_credit_accrue_milli :: proc(cat: ^Catalogs, type_idx: u16) -> u32 {
	nt := &cat.node_types[type_idx]
	dividend := i64(cat.balance.cap_fraction_permille) * i64(nt.throughput_units)
	return u32(dividend / i64(cat.balance.packet_bandwidth))
}
core/flow.odin:624+628:
	ceil_cap := (accrue + 999) / 1000
	return 1000 * ceil_cap
core/flow.odin:651:
			c := f.spawn_credit_milli[i] + accrue
detail: throughput_units loads via lenient jint with no range validation (missing→0, negative, near-i32-max all load). The new u32 credit math then wraps silently — inverting or killing the cap — violating the project's own 'never wrap through the cast' fail-fast bar.
recommended_fix: Fail-fast validate throughput_units at catalog load (terminal throughput ≥ 1, bounded so 1000×throughput÷packet_bandwidth < u32::MAX), mirroring cap_fraction_permille; or keep the credit math in i64 and range-check before any u32 cast.
